header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: (close together)”, the Prophet ﷺ said. After narrating this hadith, the narrator of the hadith, Hazrat Yazid (RH), pointed with his index finger and middle finger. That is, just as these two fingers are close together, so Rasulullah ﷺ and that woman will be close together on the Day of Qiyamah. Rasulullah ﷺ explained what is meant by the woman with a darkened face: “That widowed woman, although she was a woman of beauty and charm, and of status and honour, did not remarry out of concern for the care of her orphaned children (until those children reached maturity and no longer needed their mother, or until they died)”. This hadith is narrated by Hazrat Awf ibn Malik Ashja'i (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ مُوْسَي اْلاَشْعَرِيِّ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا قَعَدَ يَتِيْمٌ مَعَ قَوْمٍ عَلَي قَصْعَتِهِمْ فَيَقْرُبَ قَصَْعَتَهُمْ شَيْطَانٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط وفيه: الحسن بن واصل وهو الحسن بن دينار وهو ضعيف لسوء حفظه وهو حديث حسن والله اعلم مجمع الزوائد:٨ /٢٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whichever group of people an orphan child sits and eats with from their dish, Shaytan will not come near that dish.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَجُلاً شَكَا اِلَي رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قَسْوَةَ قَلْبِهِ، فَقَالَ: اِمْسَحْ رَاْسَ الْيَتِيْمِ، وَاَطْعِمِ الْمِسْكِيْنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد: ٨ /٢٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates: “A man complained to Rasulullah ﷺ that his heart was hard.” “Keep stroking the head of the orphan! And feed the poor!” the Prophet ﷺ
